scripts.lint: eslint . && uv run ruff check services/platform/src services/platform/tests tests scripts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && uv run mypy services/platform/src
scripts.contracts:check: uv run python scripts/contracts/export_openapi.py --check && uv run python scripts/contracts/generate_ts_client.py --check
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "**/*.{js,mjs,ts,tsx,json,css,md,yml,yaml}" && uv run ruff format --check services/platform/src services/platform/tests tests scripts
